captions.detailed: A small, matte-black home-video camcorder with a rectangular main body, a front-facing lens barrel, a side screen, and a top-mounted mode dial. The side screen is mounted on a vertical hinge that allows it to swing outward, and below its recess are three small, rectangular push buttons that depress independently. The front lens features a rotating outer ring, and the top mode dial is a separate component that rotates continuously on its vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact family camcorder with a rectangular main body, a front lens barrel, a side screen, and a top-mounted mode dial. Implement joint articulations so that the side screen rotates outward on a vertical hinge, the front lens ring rotates continuously, the top mode dial rotates on its vertical axis, and three small rectangular buttons under the screen recess can depress independently.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a filleted Box primitive, then cut a side recess for the screen and three small slots for the buttons. Model the lens barrel and its rotating ring using concentric Cylinder primitives. Create the top mode dial and the three buttons using small Cylinder and Box primitives, respectively. Define the articulations using revolute joints for the screen hinge, continuous joints for the lens ring and top dial, and prismatic joints for the three independent push buttons.
